description: This file contains the implementation of a builder class for creating instances of ImmutableJsonFieldSelector. It allows adding, removing, and managing JSON pointers and field definitions to construct a complex JSON field selector object.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonFieldSelectorBuilder
classes.description: A thread-unsafe builder class for constructing ImmutableJsonFieldSelector instances by adding/removing JSON pointers and field definitions.

classes.name: JsonPointerIterator
classes.description: An internal iterator class to traverse JSON pointers within the builder.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new, empty instance of the builder.

methods.name: addPointerString
methods.description: Adds a JSON pointer to the set based on a string.

methods.name: addPointerStrings
methods.description: Adds multiple JSON pointers from an iterable of strings.

methods.name: addPointer
methods.description: Adds a JSONPointer object to the set.

methods.name: addFieldDefinition
methods.description: Adds a field definition by extracting its pointer.

methods.name: addFieldSelector
methods.description: Adds another field selector's pointers to this builder.

methods.name: addFieldSelectorString
methods.description: Adds a field selector from a string using parse options.

methods.name: addFieldSelectorString
methods.description: Overloaded method: adds a field selector string with default parse options.

methods.name: removePointer
methods.description: Removes a JSONPointer from the set.

methods.name: removePointerString
methods.description: Removes a pointer based on its string representation.

methods.name: removeFieldDefinition
methods.description: Removes a field definition by its pointer.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs and returns the ImmutableJsonFieldSelector based on added pointers.
